description: SDRIF2013 - Grands aéroports - Ile-de-France is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The "Île-de-France 2030" Master Plan was adopted by the Regional Council on 18 October 2013, approved by the State on 27 December and published on 28 December 2013 in the Official Journal. This publication follows the favourable opinion issued on 17 December by the Council of State. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "SDRIF2013 - Large airports - Ile-de-France" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include planification, transport, 2013, sdrif, ile-de-france, iau. The listing shows 2021-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
